title: Establish ecological color system and variable type density for dashboard compactification
creator: Asha Patel
description: Replace legacy palette maps with an "ecological" token system that models color as contextual tone-axes rather than fixed swatches; introduce density-aware typography scale, proportional radius steps, and a shadow 'ladder' for compact dashboard surfaces. Goal is to reduce perceptual clutter at small sizes while preserving contrast and brand anchors. Deliverables: token spec (palette+type+radius+shadow), migration script, component token mapping, Figma kit, and rollout plan.
comments: 2025-11-06: Kickoff with PM and Eng. Agreed scope: palette conversion + compact typography only for v1; defer interactive state tokens to follow-up. Action: design to prototype in Figma by 2025-12-01.

2025-12-10: Early prototype shows better density at 12px body; introduced a variable type scale (12/13/14/16) tied to container density token. Trade-off: smaller body sizes require increased line-height; raised concern about table row height with existing components.

2026-01-20: Accessibility review - contrast tests against dark surfaces passed for primary/secondary axes but tertiary accents failed for 3:1. Decided to collapse tertiary accent into neutral tint layer for compact mode to preserve legibility.

2026-02-02: Engineering review (ENG-44221) highlighted runtime token expansion cost for per-tenant theme overrides. Decision: ship canonical token sets and provide a lightweight runtime aliasing layer instead of per-request computation. Follow-up: ENG to estimate aliasing shim (ENG-44221).

2026-02-18: Design review with Brand - agreed to preserve saturated brand anchor colors but expose them only as explicit 'brand' tokens (not automatic density-derived colors). Lena to produce final Figma kit and token export mappings.

2026-03-03: Created migration checklist and token-mapping script prototype. Found three components that require manual adjustment: data table rows, compact chips, and mini-cards. Added sub-issues for those components.
2026-03-10: Draft spec posted for cross-team review. PM requested rollout plan with canary on Dedicated and Private first. Added Release: design-2026.04. Awaiting Eng estimate for rollout window.
